trailhead.label: Pappagallo restaurant, Madonna di Campiglio, the APT’s start

cautions: Cattle graze on the pastures round Malga Ritort in summer.
Village streets in Madonna di Campiglio at the start.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.
